name: Reading direction inverts the template
name_fr: Le sens de lecture inverse le gabarit

origin.campaign: August 2026 — observation campaign, verdicts on scripts and on rare genres (2026-08-08)

seen.excerpt: In Arabic the page number changes corner, the order of the metadata fields is reversed, the asterisk moves in front of the name — and a page range 112-129 is displayed as 129-112. A sort by position on the page returns the reverse of the right order, silently, and the value that comes out is wrong rather than missing.
seen.reserve: observation cited from the August campaign; the documents of that wave were not kept by identifier, so this form has no reproducible example yet

prevention.refusal_clause: read the direction declared by the document and never infer order from position on the page; in a structured source the order is in the markup, not in the coordinates

repair.note: a reversed range is a wrong value, not a spurious edge; classified by judgment, not measured

history.event: created from the August 2026 verdicts on scripts and on rare genres, which the atlas had never carried
